title: Advance relative and absolute positions
evidence_or_gap: Position and Right keep adjacent text on screen. The sampled Right wrap uses the remaining print width and matches both the DOS native save and Standard Printer disk output. The short Position/Right case also matches the checkpoint replay. Other directions and wrap configurations remain open. [Ticket 7 comparisons](#ticket-7-advance-comparisons)

title: Do not advance beyond the current page
evidence_or_gap: Down keeps the requested 3 inches and clamps the baseline at 10 inches. The fresh save and unchanged Save As match the captured input file. Both sampled edit-and-reopen cases match DOS through the first save and subsequent Save As, including the new Fast Save Yes packet layout. The 180-byte Down printer stream matches the checkpoint replay. Other native layouts and page-boundary cases remain open. [Ticket 7 comparisons](#ticket-7-advance-comparisons)
